description: This Java source file defines the final class ModelRelation, which models the <relation> element within the entity modeling framework of Apache OFBiz. It includes methods for creating, accessing, and serializing relationship metadata between entities, such as relation type, related entity name, foreign key details, and key mappings.

classes.name: ModelRelation
classes.description: Immutable class that models the <relation> element in OFBiz's entity framework, encapsulating relation metadata such as relation type, related entity, foreign key name, and key mappings.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ModelRelation with specified attributes or from an XML Element.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns a string that uniquely identifies this relation, combining entity name and relation details.

methods.name: getCombinedName
methods.description: Returns a combined string of relation title and related entity name for display purposes.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the relation.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the relation type, e.g., 'one' or 'many'.

methods.name: getRelEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related entity.

methods.name: getFkName
methods.description: Returns the foreign key name associated with this relation.

methods.name: getKeyMaps
methods.description: Returns the list of key mappings that define how to relate columns between entities.

methods.name: isAutoRelation
methods.description: Indicates whether the relation was auto-generated by the system.

methods.name: findKeyMap
methods.description: Searches for and returns a key map matching a specified field name.

methods.name: findKeyMapByRelated
methods.description: Searches for and returns a key map matching a related field name.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the relation metadata into an XML DOM element.
